source_refs.note: Book p. 262-263: heading printed 14.1.6; i, j, k, [x,y,z] = xi + yj + zk, Unit Vector, u + v in i, j, k, Examples 2-3, figure. Book error: Ex 3 solution prints u = 4i+6j+2k for v. Teaching notes ours.

blocks.title: Numbering note
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ko 14.1.6 chhaapti hai (Book# 14.1.6). Kitab mein 14.1.1 naam ki koi heading hai hi nahin, is liye portal 14.1 ke sub-headings ko tarteeb se 14.1.1 se 14.1.8 tak number karta hai. Yahan 14.1.5 wahi hai jo kitab mein 14.1.6 hai.

Bachon, ab tak hum vectors ko square brackets mein likhte aaye hain: \([x, y, z]\). Physics aur aage ke saare unit mein ek aur tareeqa bohat chalta hai: \(x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}\). Yeh tareeqa teen khaas vectors \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) par khara hai. Is subtopic mein hum yeh teen vectors, unit vector ka tasawwur aur do misaalein dekhenge.
Plane ki tarah hum \(R^{3}\) mein teen khaas vectors lete hain: \(\underline{i} = [1, 0, 0]\), \(\underline{j} = [0, 1, 0]\) aur \(\underline{k} = [0, 0, 1]\).

blocks.alt: Axes x, y, z from O. Short blue arrows i, j and k go from O to the points (1, 0, 0) on the x-axis, (0, 1, 0) on the y-axis and (0, 0, 1) on the z-axis.
blocks.caption: Unit vectors i, j, k along the x-, y- and z-axes (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: \(\underline{i}\) ki magnitude \(= \sqrt{1^{2} + 0^{2} + 0^{2}} = 1\), \(\underline{j}\) ki magnitude \(= \sqrt{0^{2} + 1^{2} + 0^{2}} = 1\) aur \(\underline{k}\) ki magnitude \(= \sqrt{0^{2} + 0^{2} + 1^{2}} = 1\). Is liye \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) ko tarteeb se x-axis, y-axis aur z-axis ke saath unit vectors (ek unit lambai wale vectors) kehte hain. Jama aur scalar se zarb ki definition istemaal karke vector \([x, y, z]\) ko yun likh sakte hain:

blocks.text_alt: u equals x, y, z equals x,0,0 plus 0,y,0 plus 0,0,z

blocks.latex: = x[1, 0, 0] + y[0, 1, 0] + z[0, 0, 1] \\ = x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}
blocks.text_alt: equals x times i plus y times j plus z times k

blocks.text: Is tarah \(R^{3}\) ka har vector \([x, y, z]\) uniquely \(x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}\) ki shakal mein likha ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yani \([3, -2, 5] = 3\underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 5\underline{k}\), aur \(2\underline{i} - \underline{k} = [2, 0, -1]\): jo unit vector likha hua na ho, us ka component sifar hai.
\(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) ko yun samjhiye: ek qadam mashriq, ek qadam shumaal, ek qadam upar. \(x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}\) batata hai ke har qism ke kitne qadam lene hain. \(x\), \(y\), \(z\) components hain.
Kyun yeh tareeqa faidemand hai: bracket wale tareeqe mein tarteeb yaad rakhni parti hai, jabke \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) wale tareeqe mein har number ke saath us ki simt likhi hoti hai.

Unit vector woh vector hai jis ki magnitude unity (yani 1) ho. Teen dimensional space mein vector \(\underline{u} = x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}\) ka unit vector \(\hat{u}\) likha jaata hai (parhte hain \"u hat\") aur yun define hota hai:

blocks.text_alt: u hat equals u over magnitude of u
u hat equals x over root of x squared plus y squared plus z squared times i, plus the same with y times j, plus the same with z times k

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Kyun: \(|\underline{u}|\) se divide karne par lambai 1 kyun hoti hai? Kisi vector ko positive number \(c\) se zarb karein to us ki lambai bhi \(c\) guna ho jaati hai. \(c = \frac{1}{|\underline{u}|}\) lein to nayi lambai \(|\underline{u}| \times \frac{1}{|\underline{u}|} = 1\), aur simt wahi rehti hai.
Istemaal: agar sawal kahe \"\(\underline{u}\) ki simt mein 5 lambai ka vector\" to jawab \(5\hat{u}\) hai. Unit vector sirf simt batata hai; lambai hum khud lagate hain.

Unit vectors \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\) aur \(\underline{k}\) ki shakal mein do vectors \(\underline{u} = [x_{1}, y_{1}, z_{1}]\) aur \(\underline{v} = [x_{2}, y_{2}, z_{2}]\) ka jama \(\underline{u} + \underline{v}\) yun likha jaata hai:

blocks.text_alt: u plus v equals x1 plus x2, y1 plus y2, z1 plus z2
equals x1 plus x2 times i plus y1 plus y2 times j plus z1 plus z2 times k

blocks.title: Example 2
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} - \underline{k}\), yani \([2, 5, -1]\).
To find: \(\underline{u}\) ki simt mein unit vector \(\hat{u}\).
Method: \(\hat{u} = \dfrac{\underline{u}}{|\underline{u}|}\). Kisi vector ko us ki apni lambai se divide karne par simt wahi rehti hai aur lambai 1 ho jaati hai. Is liye pehle magnitude chahiye, phir division.

Magnitude nikaalein
\[|\underline{u}| = \sqrt{(2)^{2} + (5)^{2} + (-1)^{2}}\]
\[= \sqrt{4 + 25 + 1} = \sqrt{30}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) ke coefficients hi components hain. \(-\underline{k}\) ka matlab z-component \(-1\) hai; yeh 1 ko bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Magnitude se divide karein
\[\hat{u} = \dfrac{\underline{u}}{|\underline{u}|} = \dfrac{2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} - \underline{k}}{\sqrt{30}}\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{30}}(2\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} - \underline{k})\]
Kyun: positive number \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{30}}\) se zarb karne se simt nahin badalti, sirf lambai chhoti ho kar 1 ho jaati hai.

Tasdeeq:
\[|\hat{u}|^{2} = \dfrac{4}{30} + \dfrac{25}{30} + \dfrac{1}{30} = \dfrac{30}{30} = 1\]
Yani \(|\hat{u}| = 1\): yeh waqai unit vector hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
(Hamari practice.) \(\underline{a} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) ki simt mein unit vector, aur 6 lambai ka vector.
\(|\underline{a}| = \sqrt{1 + 4 + 4} = \sqrt{9} = 3\), is liye \(\hat{a} = \frac{1}{3}(\underline{i} + 2\underline{j} + 2\underline{k})\).
6 lambai ka vector: \(6\hat{a} = 2\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} + 4\underline{k}\). Tasdeeq: \(\sqrt{4 + 16 + 16} = \sqrt{36} = 6\). Sahi!

Agli misaal se pehle ek baat: parallel hona saabit karne ke liye humein koi naya formula nahin chahiye, sirf yeh dikhana hai ke ek vector doosre ka multiple hai. Aasaan tareeqa yeh hai ke sab se chhote coefficients wala vector (yahan \(\underline{u}\)) bunyad bana lein, aur baaqi vectors mein se common factor nikaal kar dekhein ke bracket mein wahi \(\underline{u}\) bachta hai ya nahin. Agar bachta hai to kaam khatam.

blocks.title: Example 3
blocks.problem: If \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 4\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) and \(\underline{w} = -6\underline{i} - 9\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\), then show that \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) and \(\underline{w}\) are parallel to each other.
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = 2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = 4\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = -6\underline{i} - 9\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\).
To prove: teenon vectors parallel hain.
Method: do vectors tab parallel hain jab ek doosre ka non-zero scalar multiple ho. Is liye hum koshish karenge ke \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) ko \(\underline{u}\) ke multiple ki shakal mein likhein.

\(\underline{v}\) ko \(\underline{u}\) ki shakal mein likhein
\[\underline{v} = 4\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\]
\[= 2(2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}) = 2\underline{u}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{v}\) ka har coefficient \(\underline{u}\) ke coefficient ka do guna hai (4 = 2 x 2, 6 = 2 x 3, 2 = 2 x 1), is liye 2 common factor ban kar bahar aa jaata hai.

\(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) ka nateeja
\[\underline{v} = 2\underline{u}\]
Is liye \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\) parallel hain, aur kyunke \(2 > 0\) hai is liye dono ki simt bhi ek hi hai.
Kyun: parallel vectors ki definition yahi hai.

\(\underline{w}\) ko \(\underline{u}\) ki shakal mein likhein
\[\underline{w} = -6\underline{i} - 9\underline{j} - 3\underline{k}\]
\[= -3(2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k}) = -3\underline{u}\]
Is liye \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) bhi parallel hain, lekin \(-3 < 0\) hone ki wajah se simt ulti hai.
Kyun: \(\underline{w}\) ka har coefficient \(\underline{u}\) ke coefficient ka \(-3\) guna hai. Negative multiple bhi parallel hi kehlata hai.

Lehaza
\(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) dono \(\underline{u}\) ke multiples hain, is liye \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) aapas mein parallel hain.
Kyun: \(\underline{w} = -3\underline{u} = -\frac{3}{2}\underline{v}\), yani \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) bhi ek doosre ke multiples hain.

Tasdeeq: components ke ratios.
\(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{u}\): \(\frac{4}{2} = \frac{6}{3} = \frac{2}{1} = 2\).
\(\underline{w}\) aur \(\underline{u}\): \(\frac{-6}{2} = \frac{-9}{3} = \frac{-3}{1} = -3\).
Har jore mein saare ratios barabar hain.
blocks.answer: \(\underline{v} = 2\underline{u}\) and \(\underline{w} = -3\underline{u}\), so \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) and \(\underline{w}\) are parallel to each other.

blocks.title: Dhyan dein
blocks.text: Parallel ka matlab \"ek hi line par\" nahin hai. Parallel vectors alag alag jagah par bhi ho sakte hain, bas un ki lines ek doosre ke parallel honi chahiye. Aur ulti simt wale vectors bhi parallel hi kehlate hain; exam mein \(\underline{w} = -3\underline{u}\) dekh kar \"parallel nahin\" likhna bohat aam ghalti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Example 3 ke hal ki pehli line mein kitab \(\underline{u} = 4\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k} = 2(2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k})\) chhaapti hai. \(4\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k}\) to \(\underline{v}\) hai, \(\underline{u}\) nahin; sahi line \(\underline{v} = 4\underline{i} + 6\underline{j} + 2\underline{k} = 2(2\underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + \underline{k})\) hai, jis se \(\underline{v} = 2\underline{u}\) milta hai jaisa kitab aage likhti hai. Upar hal mein humne sahi likha hai.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Kya \(\underline{a} = \underline{i} - 2\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) aur \(\underline{b} = -2\underline{i} + 4\underline{j} - 5\underline{k}\) parallel hain?
Jawab: ratios \(\frac{-2}{1} = -2\), \(\frac{4}{-2} = -2\), lekin \(\frac{-5}{3}\) barabar \(-2\) nahin. Ek ratio bhi alag ho to vectors parallel nahin.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
\(\underline{i} = [1, 0, 0]\), \(\underline{j} = [0, 1, 0]\), \(\underline{k} = [0, 0, 1]\) axes ke saath unit vectors hain.
\([x, y, z] = x\underline{i} + y\underline{j} + z\underline{k}\); coefficients hi components hain.
Unit vector: \(\hat{u} = \dfrac{\underline{u}}{|\underline{u}|}\), lambai 1, simt \(\underline{u}\) wali.
Parallel test: ek vector doosre ka non-zero multiple ho.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
\(-\underline{k}\) ko dekh kar z-component sifar samajhna: woh \(-1\) hai.
Unit vector mein sirf ek component ko \(|\underline{u}|\) se divide karna; har component divide hota hai.
Negative multiple ko parallel na maanna: \(\underline{w} = -3\underline{u}\) bhi \(\underline{u}\) ke parallel hai, bas simt ulti hai.
